description: This line plot, titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature," illustrates Pass@8 accuracy across varying generation temperatures, measured on the merged sets of AIME 2024 and AMC. The x-axis represents Temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 in linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8), ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 in linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. Three lines are plotted: the 'On-policy RL' line is yellow with triangle markers, starting at approximately 63.0 at temperature 0.1, rising to 72.0 at 0.5, peaking at 72.0 at 0.6, then declining to 73.0 at 1.0. The 'LUFFY' line is red with star markers, beginning at 76.0 at 0.1, rising to a peak of 81.0 at 0.8, then stabilizing at 80.0 at 1.0. The 'SFT' line is teal with inverted triangle markers, starting at 73.0 at 0.1, dropping to a minimum of 68.0 at 0.5, and recovering to 74.0 at 1.0.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates Pass@8 accuracy across varying generation temperatures, measured on the merged sets of AIME 2024 and AMC. The 'On-policy RL' line (yellow, triangle markers) shows a steady increase from approximately 63.0 at 0.1 to 75.0 at 0.8, followed by a slight decline to 73.0 at 1.0. The 'LUFFY' line (red, star markers) demonstrates consistent superiority, starting at 76.0 at 0.1 and peaking at 81.0 at 0.8, before stabilizing at 80.0 at 1.0. The 'SFT' line (teal, inverted triangle markers) begins at 73.0 at 0.1, dips sharply to 68.0 at 0.5, and recovers to 74.0 at 1.0, showing the most variability among the three methods. Overall, LUFFY consistently outperforms the other methods across all temperature settings, with On-policy RL showing the most significant improvement over time.
